key_takeaways: Social media templates (especially vertical/Reels) are the highest demand category in 2026
Niche specialization beats general templates - pick an industry or audience
Vertical formats (9:16, 4:5) are essential - horizontal is secondary
Price individual templates at $12-18, bundles at $25-75 for optimal conversion
B2B and industry-specific templates have lower competition than lifestyle/personal templates
2026 design trends favor 'imperfect,' textured, and playful aesthetics over sterile minimalism
Canva links are the preferred delivery method over static files
Start with 3-5 listings in a specific niche rather than scattered templates
